sourcePolicy.minecraftWikiUse: Do not fetch, crawl, summarize, or cite Minecraft Wiki pages as machine evidence. Treat Minecraft Wiki as human-only background outside automated workflows.
factPriority: PaperMC official documentation and API artifacts
Structured community datasets with explicit source policy and machine-readable data

sourceTiers.title: Canonical official data
useFor: version identity, release order, pack formats, generated reports, vanilla asset/data paths, and Paper support facts
claims that must be precise for target-version code generation
examples: Mojang version manifest and per-version metadata
official client/server jars and generated data reports
PaperMC downloads API and Paper Javadocs
limits: does not explain every gameplay behavior or authoring convention
jar-derived observations still need non-guarantees when they are not normative schemas

sourceTiers.title: minecraft-skills derived data
useFor: fast local lookups, version comparisons, schema-like observed shapes, migration planning, and validation preflights
limits: derived surfaces prove only the guarantees documented by their fact surface
missing extracted data is a gap, not permission to guess

sourceTiers.title: Structured community datasets
useFor: supplemental searchable indexes when official data is too low-level
candidate expansion for blocks, items, entities, recipes, protocol metadata, assets, and generated data history
limits: not canonical unless corroborated by Mojang or Paper sources
respect each upstream project's license, source notes, and update cadence

sourceTiers.title: Human-reviewed guidance
useFor: workflow ordering, output guardrails, response patterns, and source-use policy
limits: must not introduce version facts without backing data
must mark assumptions and unverified behavior as gaps

sourceTiers.title: Human-only background
useFor: manual maintainer reading outside automated AI retrieval
limits: not fetched, crawled, summarized, or cited by AI tools
not redistributed or closely paraphrased in package data, skills, docs, or generated answers

prohibitedAutomation: Do not fetch, crawl, summarize, or cite Minecraft Wiki pages in AI workflows.
Do not copy or closely paraphrase upstream prose from Minecraft Wiki, Paper docs, Javadocs, or community datasets.
Do not treat community structured datasets as canonical when Mojang or Paper data disagrees or is unavailable.

recommendedCommunityDatasets.title: PrismarineJS minecraft-data
useFor: blocks, items, entities, recipes, commands, protocol versions, features, sounds, and language-index lookups
limits: supplemental structured data; some upstream data has historical wiki-derived source notes
must be cross-checked before making canonical target-version claims

recommendedCommunityDatasets.title: PrismarineJS minecraft-assets
useFor: resourcepack asset names, image-oriented asset indexes, and legacy texture mapping candidates
limits: supplemental asset dataset; prefer official jar extraction for canonical vanilla path presence

recommendedCommunityDatasets.title: misode mcmeta
useFor: version-controlled generated data/assets history, assets-json, data-json, summaries, registries, and diffs
limits: community processed dataset; use as structured corroboration and import source, not as a prose authority
